scope: Research links and governance observations; not physical execution

papers.title: Reproducible Builds and Insights from an Independent Verifier for Arch Linux
papers.finding: Independent rebuilds can identify source-to-binary discrepancies, but identical binaries do not establish a trustworthy compiler.

papers.title: USBIPS Framework: Protecting Hosts from Malicious USB Peripherals
papers.finding: Cross-layer malicious-peripheral attacks exceed simple interface/path allowlists; evaluated solution targets Windows, not this Linux Fastboot host.

papers.title: Kettle: Attested Builds for Verifiable Software Provenance
papers.finding: TEE-backed attestation binds source/toolchain/environment to artifact digests; it does not prove code safety or compiler semantic correctness.

papers.title: From Agent Traces to Trust: A Survey of Evidence Tracing and Execution Provenance in LLM Agents
papers.finding: Typed execution provenance and evidence traces can show which observation supports which claim; final output alone is insufficient.

gates.acceptance: Independent reviewer approval and enforced required checks for a subsequent candidate, with a provider-observed rejected unapproved merge.
gates.rollback: No automated revert or delete; preserve the merged SHA and raise explicit governance correction.

gates.acceptance: Two independently provisioned builders produce byte-identical outputs for the same source HEAD and disclosed toolchains; report differing trust roots.
gates.rollback: Do not distribute unverified binary; retain all build receipts.

gates.acceptance: With explicit consent on sacrificial hardware, verify device descriptor stability and fail-closed behavior under reconnect/race tests; no flash/unlock/erase.
gates.rollback: Disconnect transport safely and retain host-only mode.

gates.acceptance: Independently verify build provenance bound to source, toolchain and artifact hashes or label as unauthenticated CI log.
gates.rollback: Preserve provenance statements as untrusted and stop promotion.

gates.acceptance: Every release claim has an exact SHA, execution environment, observable log and explicit scope; missing evidence stays a typed nonzero gap.
gates.rollback: Demote claim to hypothesis, without deleting historical records.

gates.acceptance: A CI record on exact merge SHA or independent binary equivalence receipt; do not inherit parent-head PASS blindly.
gates.rollback: No production release on unverified merge artifact.

gates.acceptance: Complete prior-art review and independent scientific review before claims of invention, theorem or academic validation.
gates.rollback: Use 'engineering study' status and preserve source authorship.

gates.acceptance: Human review of logging/consent/accessibility/child-protection and respect for local cultures before broad deployment.
gates.rollback: Retain private, minimal data collection and no external sharing.
